jobs.occupation: Cream Consulting by Audensiel - Functional Analyst in Energy Domain
jobs.description:
What IS cream all about ?

We could be a Cream Factory, a cooking blog or even a detective agency...

But in reality, we are a Business & Technology consulting company, active in large organizations and industry leaders in Banking, Insurance, Telecom, Energy, & Transport.

The Cream recipe:

- 1/3 personal development - 1/3 collective intelligence - 1/3 intrapreneurship - bonus ingredient: some passionate colleagues

Your future projects :

Like Morgane, Functional Analyst at Cream, you act as a bridge between business and IT teams within the banking sector. You translate business needs into functional specifications for digital platforms such as mobile applications, AI solutions or e-Commerce tools. Your projects may relate to payments, credit or compliance for example.

Our clients of the energy sector produce and transport electricity and gas for the Belgian market. To support their specific business issues, they develop in-house IT products.

In order to run Energy projects related to smart metering, electrical network stability, customers and contracts management, gas flow management, legal regulations, real time data management, energy management trading, Grid maintenance and development, etc. the Functional Analyst captures, consolidates and communicates the information from the various business stakeholders to the IT teams in order to provide them the necessary pieces of information to create a new solution.
Your tasks will be

• Translating business requirements into a structured IT solution while keeping a functional approach

• Using your energy industry knowledge to help translating this functional design into well-tailored technical design

• Collaborating with the business analysts for proper translation of the needs

• Preparing functional integration test cases based on the requirements

• Testing of the product before delivery to the users

• Analysing potential corrective actions to be taken

• Following up of technical designers and programmers

• Being able to go into technical details

• Working closely with the business to ensure the final solution fits their needs

What do we expect from our Consultant ?

• You have a Master Degree in information technologies, electricity, electronics or equivalent

• You have a proven experience in Functional Analysis

• Very good knowledge of Energy Market issues and modelling tools and methodologies among others:

• generation, transportation, metering, billing, Grid management, asset management, contract management, gas flow management, risk management, portfolio management, power optimization, energy trading, real time applications ... as you can interact with energy markets specialiss

• UML, RUP...

• An experience in IT projects based on Microsoft architecture (.NET, Visual Studio, SQL Server, TFS) could be a real asset

• Nice to have: knowledge of a testing framework or automation tool (NUnit, QTP)

• You are able to make the bridge between technical and business experts worlds

• You can meet project deadlines and provide high quality deliverables

• You have high communications skills and analytical skills

• You are rigorous

• You are capable to think out of the box and maintain in the meantime a pragmatic approach.

• You are able to work with autonomy while being also a great team player

• You are fluent in French and English, a good knowledge of Dutch is also required

• You are committed to travelling abroad occasionally upon the client's request

-

As a Salesforce Technical Lead Consultant, you lead the technical delivery of Salesforce projects from solution design to implementation. You work closely with consultants and business stakeholders to translate requirements into scalable, secure, and high-performing solutions.

You combine technical leadership with a hands-on approach. From supporting pre-sales and defining solution architectures to mentoring developers and contributing code yourself, you’re as comfortable presenting ideas in the boardroom as solving technical challenges in the codebase.

Experience with Salesforce architecture, integrations, and DevOps is essential. Professional proficiency in both Dutch and English is required. Experience in life sciences, regulatory compliance, and data security is a plus.

For an international production company specializing in high-quality technologies in Izegem, we are looking for a CNC Machine Loader (day shift).

What will you do?

• Loading and unloading CNC machines: inserting and removing parts based on the production order
• Ensuring an optimal production flow, both for series and single-piece work
• Performing fine deburring work on produced parts
• Carrying out quality controls on machined parts
• Replacing tools and making corrections where necessary
• Contributing to an orderly and tidy workplace with an eye for safety

Who are you?

• Background in metal or CNC
• Good fine motor skills and eye for detail
• Strong mechanical insight and ability to read technical drawings
• Team player with a strong sense of responsibility
• Willing to work in a 2-shift system
• Good knowledge of English

We are looking for a Technical Assistant to support the PALL (Product Assessment & Laundry Laboratory) team during a temporary assignment. In this hands-on role, you will perform laundry and wash performance tests, take technical measurements before and after washing cycles, maintain laboratory stock, and ensure accurate data collection and reporting. You will work in a team of three Technical Assistants and receive training on various testing methods and equipment.

In a nutshell you will: 

 
• Perform laundry and wash performance tests according to established procedures. 
 

 
• Take measurements using laboratory equipment (e.g. spectrophotometer). 
 
• Record, verify, and upload test data accurately. 
Maintain testing materials and laboratory stock. 

 
• Communicate with internal stakeholders regarding test requests, observations, and results. 
 
•  
Report any irregularities or unexpected findings during testing.

 
• Available full-time from September 22 through December 23. 
 

 
• Able to work daily from 7:30 AM to 4:00 PM. 
 
•  
Accurate, reliable, and detail-oriented. 

 
•  
Comfortable working in a practical, laboratory-based environment. 

 
• Good communication skills in English. 
 

 
• Basic computer skills (Outlook, Excel, and willingness to learn internal systems). 
 

 
• Open to coaching and eager to learn new testing methods. 
 
•  
Able to handle laundry baskets of approximately 3 kg using provided ergonomic equipment.

We are looking for an enthusiastic CNC miller for our production department.
 
Our client develops and manufactures modular systems for the live communications sector.
 
As a CNC miller, you will mill aluminum profiles according to drawings.
 
You will alternate between batch production and custom work.
 
In addition, you will use an ERP system to process production orders.
 
You will also be responsible for creating milling programs, setting up the milling machine, loading and unloading the machine, and performing quality checks.
 
Furthermore, you will perform first-line maintenance on the machine. 

• Experience as a CNC miller

• Ability to read blueprints and knowledge of using measuring instruments

• Quality-oriented, with a sense of order and neatness

• You are fluent in English

• Willing to work in a two-shift system

• Team player with a positive attitude

I am looking for an energetic, friendly and kind trilingual secretary to join my new private gynaecological practice.
 

The successful candidate must be fluent in Dutch, English and French. This is a part-time, on-site position starting on 7 December 2026.
 

Responsibilities include:
 
 

• Answering telephone calls and assisting patients 

• Managing the reception desk 

• Scheduling and following up on appointments 

• Tracking and ordering practice supplies 

• Cleaning and preparing medical instruments according to protocol 

• Supporting the smooth day-to-day running of the practice  

A warm, professional and patient-centred attitude is essential.
